1.title: Trump Dismisses Reports About Dire Conditions Aboard U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln
1.summary: Asked whether the deployment of the Abraham Lincoln had gone on too long, the president said its deployment had lasted “not nearly long enough.”

2.title: Justice Dept. Dismisses Threats Case in Minnesota Days Before Trial
2.summary: The government said it could not prove that a man accused of threatening federal agents had committed a crime, adding to the scores of cases in the administration’s deportation efforts that have unraveled.

3.title: Colorado Was Targeted as Trump Fumed Over Election Denier, Email Shows
3.summary: The state has accused the government in a lawsuit of retaliating after the conviction of Tina Peters, a Trump supporter. An administration official convened a group to discuss “immediate actions.”

4.title: Jason Arday, Cambridge Professor Accused of Plagiarism, Is Found Dead
4.summary: Mr. Arday resigned last week after the university announced an investigation into allegations of plagiarism and fabrication.

5.title: Russia Campaigned to Derail Moldova’s Pro-Western Government
5.summary: In Moldova, Moscow paid Orthodox priests, conducted a vote-buying scheme and set up training camps on election interference — all in an effort to derail the Western-leaning government.

6.title: Dozens injured and thousands evacuated in Croatia wildfire
6.summary: Officials say the blaze, near the port town of Omis, is one of the worst in Croatia's history.
